scope: Actual two-agent author/reviewer exchange, separate fresh pipe bridges with no shared terminal or exec handle. Reuses the verified native graph artifact; no extra native compilation.

reviewer.scope: Actual independent reviewer agent RPCs over a fresh pipe bridge; no author exec handle or terminal used. Graph uses a source/executable-hash verified native artifact.

author_finish.scope: Author agent independently reconnects after reviewer agent disconnect; observes retained mutation and explicitly stops its host.
